name: GBTW Continuation In-Flight Suppression (G1)
goal: Make the GBTW Stop hook's continuation check honor a live in-flight Agent subagent (backlog G1), using the completion-aware signal the tasks-in-progress block and code-review gate already use, without ever false-silencing a genuine stall.

tasks.name: Wire completion-aware in-flight detection into the continuation suppression
tasks.description: The GBTW continuation-check suppression (get-back-to-work-impl.sh ~:924-950, the _BG_JOB_ACTIVE block) uses an ad-hoc last-3-turns check for named waiting tools + Bash run_in_background and does NOT consult the completion-aware _gbtw_extract_in_flight (which detects Agent async_launched). So a live Agent subagent gets its 'holding' turn graded D (G1). FIX: add a pure helper _gbtw_continuation_suppressed_by_inflight() = _gbtw_review_gate_suppress true AND NOT _gbtw_should_rearm_check; replace the _BG_JOB_ACTIVE stanza with a call to it. The decision logic is unit-tested via the GBTW_TEST_MODE=1 seam; the WIRING is guarded by a structural two-grep falsifier (reverting the stanza fails it). Completion-aware -> a finished/killed subagent still fires the check (no false-silence, S1). Fail-open (S2). Scope: ONLY get-back-to-work-impl.sh + a new test in worker/hooks/tests/; leave the tasks-in-progress block, the holding/waiting last-line stanza (:958-968), the LLM prompts, and the firing matrix unchanged.

steps.description: RED: create worker/hooks/tests/test-gbtw-continuation-suppression.sh, modeled on tests/test-gbtw-inflight.sh: resolve SCRIPT_DIR, HOOKS_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/..", FIXTURES_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/fixtures"; `GBTW_TEST_MODE=1 source "$HOOKS_DIR/get-back-to-work-claude.sh"` (the wrapper delegates to impl and exposes the _gbtw_* helpers). PART 1 (behavioral) — assert_eq over `_gbtw_continuation_suppressed_by_inflight <fixture> <stage> <context>`: f1-subagent-in-flight.jsonl,'executing','' -> 'true'; f5-bash-bg-in-flight.jsonl,'executing','' -> 'true'; w1-monitor-last-turn.jsonl,'executing','' -> 'true'; f2-subagent-completed.jsonl,'executing','' -> '' (S1 no false-silence); f7-all-terminal-statuses.jsonl,'executing','' -> '' (killed/failed/etc.); a minimal inline STALL fixture (2 plain assistant turns, no tool, no job) ,'executing','' -> ''; f1-subagent-in-flight.jsonl,'executing',<a checkpoint/query-offload proposal string that _ic_is_antipattern_proposal recognizes — verify against tests/test-antipattern-lexicon.sh> -> '' (re-armed). PART 2 (structural wiring falsifier): assert `grep -c '_gbtw_continuation_suppressed_by_inflight "$TRANSCRIPT_PATH"' "$HOOKS_DIR/get-back-to-work-impl.sh"` == 1 (the runtime call-site; distinct from the def which uses $1/$2/$3); assert `grep -c '_BG_JOB_ACTIVE' "$HOOKS_DIR/get-back-to-work-impl.sh"` == 0 (the removed block).
steps.expected: FAIL - _gbtw_continuation_suppressed_by_inflight undefined (behavioral cases fail), the call-site grep == 0 (helper not wired yet), and _BG_JOB_ACTIVE grep == 3 (old block still present).

steps.description: GREEN part A (helper): in get-back-to-work-impl.sh after _gbtw_should_rearm_check (~:140) / near _gbtw_review_gate_suppress (:215-226) and BEFORE the GBTW_TEST_MODE shim (:228), add: _gbtw_continuation_suppressed_by_inflight() { local transcript="$1" stage="$2" context="$3"; [ "$(_gbtw_review_gate_suppress "$transcript")" = "true" ] || return 0; if [ "$(_gbtw_should_rearm_check "$stage" "$context")" = "true" ]; then return 0; fi; printf 'true'; return 0; }
steps.expected: helper defined; behavioral fixtures resolve; the call-site grep is still 0 until Step 3.

steps.description: GREEN part B (wire): replace the FIRE_CONTINUATION _BG_JOB_ACTIVE block at ~:924-950 (the `if [ "$FIRE_CONTINUATION" = "true" ]; then _BG_RECENT_REQ_IDS=... _BG_JOB_ACTIVE=... <inner re-arm> fi`) with: if [ "$FIRE_CONTINUATION" = "true" ] && [ "$(_gbtw_continuation_suppressed_by_inflight "$TRANSCRIPT_PATH" "$WORKFLOW_STAGE" "$RECENT_CONTEXT")" = "true" ]; then FIRE_CONTINUATION="false"; log_hook "GET-BACK-TO-WORK" "Suppressed" "continuation check - live in-flight job / waiting tool (completion-aware)"; fi. Leave the holding/waiting last-line stanza (:958-968) unchanged. This removes every _BG_JOB_ACTIVE occurrence.
steps.expected: reverting THIS wiring flips the structural assertions: the call-site grep goes 1->0 and _BG_JOB_ACTIVE reappears (grep 0->3). The behavioral cases stay green either way (they exercise the helper directly).

steps.description: Run the new test (behavioral + structural all PASS), the bg-detection smoke check (a self-contained replica — a no-harm 'did I break the file' check, NOT wiring coverage), and a syntax check.
steps.expected: new test: all PASS (0 failed), including grep call-site==1 and _BG_JOB_ACTIVE==0; test-bg-detection.sh: all PASS (unchanged replica); bash -n exit 0.
